messages:
sam: quick follow-up to yesterday's incident. goal: lock owners, timelines, and minimal smoke tests for the alert tuning items. short list: 
- noisy infra cpu alerts -> threshold bump + dry-run (owner: katie) target: 3d
- dedupe key for error-rate alerts -> job-level dedupe (owner: jordan) target: 7d
- paging policy tweak: low->slack-only, med->oncall daytime only (owner: matt) target: 48h + 14d grandfathering
- suppression for flapping hosts + monitoring (owner: alyssa) target: 14d
please ack and call out blockers. tagging @devops-bot to spawn task. :wave:

katie: ack. taking cpu threshold. i'll bump rule to 0.9 and run a 24h dry-run in staging first. will paste rule diff and metrics link here.

jordan: taking dedupe. prefer `job + error_signature` so autoscaled workers don't create repeated pages. will add dedupe_key to template and open PR by Thu.

matt: i'll own paging policy change. two clarifications: 1) confirm we do 14-day grandfathering for existing alerts? 2) confirm daytime window 09:00-18:00 PT?

alyssa: i can prototype suppression. plan: emit `alerts.flap_count` metric and suppress when >3 in 10m, forward suppressed incidents to suppression-review channel. need list of infra-control-plane hosts to exclude.

sam: answers: jordan -> go job-level, matt -> yes to 14 days and 09:00-18:00 PT, alyssa -> infra-control-plane excluded, i'll DM the list.

katie: rule diff i'll test tomorrow morning (dry-run):
```
# old
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.8
# proposed
expr: avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m])) > 0.9
labels:
  severity: medium
```
will watch dashboards and rollback if regressions.

jordan: dedupe template snippet i'll use: `dedupe_key: '{{ job }}:{{ error_sig }}'`. plan: PR Thu, merge Fri, validate next Mon. will add unit smoke in alerting-ci.

matt: updating paging policy doc + oncall rota. PR EOD tomorrow. will add runbook entry for suppressed but persistent issues and notify teams on pager change.

devops-bot: Task created: https://tasks.company/INFR-2227 "Alert tuning: cpu threshold, dedupe, paging policy, suppression" assigned to [katie, jordan, matt, alyssa] due 2026-05-15 :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: +1 on job-level dedupe. request: include a smoke test that generates synthetic errors to assert dedupe works and doesn't swallow unique issues.

alyssa: good call. i'll add a CI smoke job that fires a synthetic error and validates suppression/dedupe behavior. target: next Wed.

sam: thanks all. i'll consolidate into the postmortem action table and ping eng-ops later today. final checklist: 
- katie: bump + 24h dry-run (72h)
- jordan: dedupe PR + CI smoke (7d)
- matt: paging policy PR + grandfathering (48h)
- alyssa: suppression prototype + CI smoke (14d)
flag here if you need more time, otherwise i'll close the ticket and mark owners. :thumbsup:
